## Avalanche Conditions

I built a little site that pulls together live avalanche forecast, webcam, weather, and snowpack data for Cameron Pass and Hidden Valley, my two favorite areas to tour. It started out from a web-making workshop I'd attended, then I let Claude Code churn up the rest.

[Open Avalanche Conditions →](avi_conditions/index.html)
